confirmed_findings.title: Unique grade-2 entity recovery is collected but never emitted as a metric
confirmed_findings.preregistered_basis: SCOPE.md section 7 requires grade-2 question hit@10 and, separately, unique grade-2 candidates retrieved divided by all grade-2 candidates.

minimal_input.description: One condition has two grade-2-eligible synthetic questions.
minimal_input.before_fix_metric_registry_result: Question hit metric is present; auxiliary unique-grade2 recovery metric is absent.

confirmed_findings.impact: The generated interval/CSV bundle omits a preregistered auxiliary denominator and can leave readers with only question-hit coverage. This does not change C1-C3 point thresholds, and no actual experiment estimate was inspected.
confirmed_findings.verification: Imported METRICS contains no ratio entry using grade2_retrieved/gold2_count; the available per-question observation fields were verified in source.
confirmed_findings.original_source_observation: build_observations.main records grade2_retrieved and gold2_count. METRICS includes grade2_hit_at10 but no ratio with numerator grade2_retrieved and denominator gold2_count. The main loop emits only registered METRICS entries.
confirmed_findings.minimal_fix_applied: Add an explicitly auxiliary ratio metric, for example grade2_entity_recall_at10_micro = ('ratio', None, 'grade2_retrieved', 'gold2_count', 'unique frozen grade2 entities retrieved / all frozen grade2 entities'). Reuse the existing paired question bootstrap and keep H1 criteria unchanged.
confirmed_findings.fix: Added grade2_entity_recall_at10_micro using the existing paired ratio bootstrap; C1-C4 expressions are unchanged.

confirmed_findings.title: Identity-only source-order comparison can conceal a row-valid ordering reversal
confirmed_findings.preregistered_basis: SCOPE.md sections 6 and 8 require retaining separate A/P duplicate judgments and qualifying support when external and internal judging sources change condition order. judging/RULES.md preserves each row's factual scope and forbids overwriting disagreement with consensus.
confirmed_findings.impact: A source-order report can show only a tie against the external result while its own row-valid metric favors the opposite condition. If the report is used alone to assess the registered judging-source qualifier, a material sensitivity is missed. The example is synthetic and says nothing about observed AF-RES-018 orderings.
confirmed_findings.verification: Executed source_order.main with synthetic observations and in-memory load/save/ROOT replacements. It emitted external delta +1, identity-pool delta 0, status one_tie. Applying the existing direction/relation functions to the row-valid delta -1 yields reversed.
confirmed_findings.original_source_observation: useful_pools contains an entity if any discovery row is judged relevant. pool_recall then credits that identity in both conditions, even if one condition's own row is N/0/U. build_observations also computes row_valid_pool_recall, but source_order.definitions compares only pool_recall. Identity-union recall is a useful explicitly named estimand; the confirmed gap is omission of the available row-valid source-order sensitivity, not a claim that the identity metric itself must be deleted.
confirmed_findings.minimal_fix_applied: Preserve the original identity-pool comparisons and add separately named external-vs-primary-row-valid, external-vs-secondary-row-valid, and primary-vs-secondary-row-valid comparisons on their respective common eligible question sets. Report any difference between identity and row-valid orderings, and qualify final support without changing frozen gold, raw judgments, denominators, or H1 thresholds.
confirmed_findings.fix: Retained all three original identity-pool source comparisons, added three clearly named row-valid comparisons, and exposed comparison_basis/analysis_role in JSON and CSV.

checks.method: executed claims/sample.py with in-memory filesystem replacement
checks.question: Is a fixed factual claim frame sampled reproducibly and without replacement, retaining a claim per nonempty question?
checks.input: All synthetic: 100 factual claims per condition, four questions per condition, 25 literal response assertions per question, six claim-type labels.
checks.limit: This checks the sampling algorithm for an unchanged frame. It does not audit the actual frame, freeze chronology, extraction completeness, or verification judgments.

checks.question: Are grade2 hit, gold recall, N rates, claim errors, and threshold directions defined consistently?
checks.observed: Grade2 question hits exclude questions without eligible grade2 gold; gold recall uses unique matched relevant entities; returned-candidate and maximum-ten-slot N ratios are distinct; claim errors use false/(true+false), unknown/all and false/all bounds; Fraction arithmetic implements C1 >=1/5, C2 >=-1/20, C3 strictly <0, and auxiliary C4 <=1/20. Missing core denominators yield unjudgeable. Retention with uncertainty is not counted as exclusion.
checks.exception: The auxiliary grade2 entity-recovery omission is separately reported as ICR-01.

checks.question: Does normalization avoid automatically releasing first-30-word truncations?
checks.observed: Every overflow requires an override before finalize; reasons are checked <=30 whitespace words; discovery caveats are included; conversion records are emitted; key release waits for planned primary/secondary raw-judgment coverage. Duplicate A/P rows remain distinct.
checks.limit: These are code-path checks only. They do not certify semantic preservation, actual blindness, or the actual timing of key release.

checks.method: source review and restricted metadata vocabulary check
checks.question: Do programmed cohort/scope/I5 subgroup values match the frozen metadata vocabulary?
checks.note: The SCOPE prose uses not_present, while actual frozen metadata and groups both use absent; this vocabulary difference does not remove questions from the implemented 16-cell grouping.

checks.question: Are same-URL fragments and explicit finds rereads while failed/unreadable opens consume budget?
checks.input: Two opened URLs differing only in fragment, one explicit find, one failed open, one opened_empty response.

checks.question: Do consistency, counterexample, and reproduction outputs preserve the limits of internal review?
checks.observed: judge_consistency retains cross-condition row pairs and distinguishes exact payloads; it does not identify causal format bias. Counterexample selectors preserve matched cases and distinguish actual exclusion from uncertainty. reproduce uses check=True on sequential gates and describes deterministic reanalysis of preserved observations, not a fresh model replication. Human review time remains unmeasured.

uncertainties_and_unverified_contracts.subject: Frozen claim metadata and chronology
uncertainties_and_unverified_contracts.source: build_observations verifies equality of sampled/verdict claim-ID sets and list lengths; claims/sample.py is reproducible on an unchanged frame.
uncertainties_and_unverified_contracts.status: The actual SAMPLE, claim pool, verdict records, and earlier commit/freeze artifacts were not read. The code reviewed here does not alone establish that qid/condition metadata in verdict rows is identical to the frozen sample or that the sample predates checking.
uncertainties_and_unverified_contracts.recommended_check: Keep the existing freeze/provenance gates and verify identical per-ID qid/condition/source metadata plus sample-before-verification chronology. Do not resample to improve the results.

uncertainties_and_unverified_contracts.subject: Rank and candidate count validity
uncertainties_and_unverified_contracts.source: build_observations trusts recorded candidate ranks and processes the complete candidate list; reproduce calls run_inventory/protocol_audit before analysis.
uncertainties_and_unverified_contracts.status: The contents of those additional validators and actual ranks/output counts were outside this review. A <=10 output and rank-consistency invariant may be correctly enforced upstream.
uncertainties_and_unverified_contracts.recommended_check: Retain or verify upstream assertions for unique valid discovery ranks, no out-of-range top10 entries, and maximum candidate count. No missing invariant is asserted as a confirmed defect here.

uncertainties_and_unverified_contracts.subject: Semantic normalization and actual condition order
uncertainties_and_unverified_contracts.status: Actual normalization overrides, raw judgments, dispatch schedule, run timing, and frozen receipts were not inspected. Source-level guards and deterministic seed use do not prove that semantic qualifications survived or that the scheduled/randomized order was executed.
uncertainties_and_unverified_contracts.recommended_check: Use the separately scoped normalization and execution/provenance audits. Preserve raw disagreement and describe any deviation rather than substituting a consensus result.
